evidence.pali: ‘‘Dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, dīghaṃ vā passasanto ‘dīghaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti; rassaṃ vā assasanto ‘rassaṃ assasāmī’ti pajānāti, rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘rassaṃ passasāmī’ti pajānāti; ‘sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘sabbakāyapaṭisaṃvedī passasissāmī’ti sikkhati; ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assasissāmī’ti sikkhati, ‘passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passasissāmī’ti sikkhati.
evidence.chinese_simplified: “出息长时，了知：‘我出息长’；入息长时，了知：‘我入息长’。出息短时，了知：‘我出息短’；入息短时，了知：‘我入息短’。学：‘我将觉知全身而出息’；学：‘我将觉知全身而入息’。学：‘我将平静身行而出息’；学：‘我将平静身行而入息’。”
evidence.english: Breathing out long, he knows, 'I am breathing out long'; or breathing in long, he knows, 'I am breathing in long.' Breathing out short, he knows, 'I am breathing out short'; or breathing in short, he knows, 'I am breathing in short.' He trains thus: 'I shall breathe out experiencing the whole body'; he trains thus: 'I shall breathe in experiencing the whole body.' He trains thus: 'I shall breathe out calming the bodily formation'; he trains thus: 'I shall breathe in calming the bodily formation.'

entries.pali: Eseva nayo rassapadepi. Ayaṃ pana viseso – ‘‘yathā ettha ‘dīghaṃ assāsaṃ addhānasaṅkhāte’ti vuttaṃ; evamidha ‘rassaṃ assāsaṃ ittarasaṅkhāte assasatī’’ti āgataṃ. Tasmā tassa vasena yāva ‘‘tena vuccati kāye kāyānupassanāsatipaṭṭhānabhāvanā’’ti tāva yojetabbaṃ. Evamayaṃ addhānavasena ittaravasena ca imehākārehi assāsapassāse pajānanto dīghaṃ vā assasanto ‘‘dīghaṃ assasāmī’’ti pajānāti…pe… rassaṃ vā passasanto ‘‘rassaṃ passasāmī’’ti pajānātīti veditabbo.
entries.chinese_simplified: 短节也是同样的方法。然此有差别：如彼处说‘就时长而言长入息’；如此处则为‘就短暂而言短入息’。是故，应依此义，连贯至‘是故说为于身随观身之念处修习’为止。如此，此人依时长与短暂，以此诸行相了知入出息，当长入息时，了知‘我长入息’……乃至……当短出息时，了知‘我短出息’，当如是了知。
entries.english: This same method applies also to the section on the short [breath]. This, however, is the distinction: just as it is said here, 'a long out-breath in a long period of time,' so it has come [in the Paṭisambhidāmagga] here, 'one breathes out a short out-breath in a short period of time.' Therefore, by means of that [section on the short breath], it should be applied up to 'Therefore, it is said: "The development of the establishment of mindfulness by way of contemplating the body in the body".' Thus, it should be understood that this bhikkhu, knowing the out-breaths and in-breaths by these aspects—by way of a long period and by way of a short period—when breathing out long, knows, 'I am breathing out long,'… and so on… or when breathing in short, knows, 'I am breathing in short'.

entries.pali: ‘‘Dīghaṃ assāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṃ avikkhepaṃ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti. Tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sā pīti paṭisaṃviditā hoti. Dīghaṃ passāsavasena…pe… rassaṃ assāsavasena… rassaṃ passāsavasena… sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī assāsavasena… sabbakāyappaṭisaṃvedī passāsavasena… passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ assāsavasena… passambhayaṃ kāyasaṅkhāraṃ passāsavasena cittassa ekaggataṃ avikkhepaṃ pajānato sati upaṭṭhitā hoti, tāya satiyā tena ñāṇena sā pīti paṭisaṃviditā hoti. Āvajjato sā pīti paṭisaṃviditā hoti jānato… passato… paccavekkhato… cittaṃ adhiṭṭhahato… saddhāya adhimuccato… vīriyaṃ paggaṇhato… satiṃ upaṭṭhāpayato… cittaṃ samādahato… paññāya pajānato… abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānato… pariññeyyaṃ parijānato… pahātabbaṃ pajahato… bhāvetabbaṃ bhāvayato… sacchikātabbaṃ sacchikaroto sā pīti paṭisaṃviditā hoti. Evaṃ sā pīti paṭisaṃviditā hotī’’ti (paṭi. ma. 1.172).
entries.chinese_simplified: “以长入息，了知心的一境性与不散乱，其念便得以确立。以此念与此智，善知那喜。以长出息……乃至……以短入息……以短出息……觉知全身而入息……觉知全身而出息……平息身行而入息……平息身行而出息，了知心的一境性与不散乱，其念便得以确立，以此念与此智，善知那喜。作意时，善知那喜；了知时……见时……审察时……决意心时……由信胜解时……策励精进时……建立念时……等持心时……以慧了知时……证知应证知者时……遍知应遍知者时……断应断者时……修习应修习者时……作证应作证者时，善知那喜。如是，善知那喜。”
entries.english: For one who knows the one-pointedness and non-distraction of the mind by way of the long in-breath, mindfulness is established. With that mindfulness and that knowledge, that rapture is distinctly known. By way of the long out-breath… and so on… by way of the short in-breath… by way of the short out-breath… by way of experiencing the whole body with the in-breath… by way of experiencing the whole body with the out-breath… by way of calming the bodily formation with the in-breath… by way of calming the bodily formation with the out-breath, for one who knows the one-pointedness and non-distraction of the mind, mindfulness is established; with that mindfulness and that knowledge, that rapture is distinctly known. That rapture is distinctly known by one who adverts, by one who knows, by one who sees, by one who reviews, by one who resolves the mind, by one who is resolved through faith, by one who exerts effort, by one who establishes mindfulness, by one who concentrates the mind, by one who understands with wisdom, by one who directly knows what is to be directly known, by one who fully understands what is to be fully understood, by one who abandons what is to be abandoned, by one who develops what is to be developed, by one who realizes what is to be realized. In this way, that rapture is distinctly known.

entries.pali: Tassa aparabhāge kassapo nāma satthā udapādi. Tassāpi ekova sāvakasannipāto, tattha vīsatibhikkhusahassāni ahesuṃ. Tadā bodhisatto jotipālo nāma māṇavo tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū bhūmiyañceva antalikkhe ca pākaṭo ghaṭikārassa kumbhakārassa mitto ahosi, so tena saddhiṃ satthāraṃ upasaṅkamitvā dhammakathaṃ sutvā pabbajitvā āraddhavīriyo tīṇi piṭakāni uggahetvā vattasampattiyā buddhasāsanaṃ sobhesi. Sopi naṃ satthā byākāsi.
entries.chinese_simplified: 其后，名为迦叶的导师出世。他也有一次弟子集会，于彼处有两万比丘。当时，菩萨是名为光护的青年，通达三吠陀，于地上及空中皆有名望，是陶工伽提迦罗(Ghaṭikāra)的朋友。他与伽提迦罗一同去到导师跟前，听闻说法后出家，发起精进，学习三藏，以戒行圆满庄严了佛陀的教法。那位导师也为他授记。
entries.english: In a later period, the Teacher named Kassapa arose. He too had only one assembly of disciples, at which there were twenty thousand bhikkhus. At that time, the Bodhisatta was a young brahmin named Jotipāla, a master of the three Vedas, renowned on earth and in the sky. He was a friend of the potter Ghaṭikāra. Together with him, he approached the Teacher, heard the Dhamma discourse, and went forth. Having become energetic, he mastered the three Piṭakas and adorned the Buddha’s dispensation through his accomplishment in the observances. That Teacher also prophesied to him.

entries.pali: Addhānavasenā ti kāladdhānavasena. Ayañhi addhāna-saddo kālassa desassa ca vācakoti. Tattha desaddhānaṃ udāharaṇabhāvena dassetvā kāladdhānassa vasena assāsapassāsānaṃ dīgharassataṃ vibhāvetuṃ ‘‘yathā hī’’ tiādi vuttaṃ. Tattha okāsaddhāna nti okāsabhūtaṃ addhānaṃ. Pharitvā ti byāpetvā. Cuṇṇavicuṇṇāpi anekakalāpabhāvena, dīghamaddhāna nti dīghaṃ padesaṃ. Tasmā ti saṇikaṃ pavattiyā dīghasantānatāya dīghāti vuccanti. Ettha ca hatthiādisarīre sunakhādisarīre ca assāsapassāsānaṃ desaddhānavisiṭṭhena kāladdhānavaseneva dīgharassatā vuttāti veditabbā ‘‘saṇikaṃ pūretvā saṇikameva nikkhamanti, sīghaṃ pūretvā sīghameva nikkhamantī’’ti vacanato. Manussesū ti samānappamāṇesupi manussasarīresu. Dīghaṃ assasantī ti dīghaṃ assāsappabandhaṃ pavattentīti attho. Passasantī ti etthāpi eseva nayo. Sunakhasasādayo viya rassaṃ assasanti passasanti cāti yojanā. Idaṃ pana dīghaṃ rassañca assasanaṃ passasanañca tesaṃ sattānaṃ sarīrassa sabhāvoti daṭṭhabbaṃ. Tesa nti tesaṃ sattānaṃ. Te ti assāsapassāsā. Ittaramaddhāna nti appakaṃ kālaṃ. Navahākārehī ti bhāvanamanuyuñjantassa pubbenāparaṃ aladdhavisesassa kevalaṃ addhānavasena ādito vuttā tayo ākārā, te ca kho ekacco assāsaṃ suṭṭhu sallakkheti, ekacco passāsaṃ, ekacco tadubhayanti imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ vasena. Keci pana ‘‘assasatipi passasatipīti ekajjhaṃ vacanaṃ bhāvanāya nirantaraṃ pavattidassanattha’’nti vadanti. Chandavasena pubbe viya tayo, tathā pāmojjavasenāti imehi navahi ākārehi.
entries.chinese_simplified: “以时量故”，即以时间量故。这个“时量”(addhāna)一词，既可指时间，也可指空间。在此，先以空间量为例说明，再通过时间量来辨别入息和出息的长短，故说“譬如”等语。此处“空间量”(okāsaddhāna)即指作为空间的量。“遍及”(pharitvā)意为“充满”(byāpetvā)。即使是粉末，也是由众多微粒组成；“长时量”(dīghamaddhāna)即指长的区域。因此，由于缓慢地进行且长时地相续，故称为“长”。在此应当明白，在大象等的身体与狗等的身体中，入息出息的长短，是依于由空间量所限定的时间量而说的，如言：“缓慢地充满就缓慢地出来，快速地充满就快速地出来。”“在人类中”，即在身体大小相同的人类中。“长入息”的意思是，他们进行着长的入息流。“出息”也是同样的道理。应结合为：他们像狗、兔子等一样短入息和短出息。然而，这长和短的入息和出息，应被看作是那些众生身体的自性。“彼等”(tesaṃ)即指那些众生。“彼”(te)即指入息出息。“短时量”(ittaramaddhāna)即指短暂的时间。“以九种方式”是指：对于修习者，当尚未由前获得后后更高成就时，仅以时量，最初所说的三种方式，即：某人善于注意入息，某人善于注意出息，某人善于注意两者，这是就这三类人而言。然而有些人说：“‘入息亦，出息亦’这个合在一起的词，是为了显示修习的不间断进行。”以欲(chanda)故，如前有三种；同样，以喜悦(pāmojja)故有三种，如是共成九种方式。
entries.english: Addhānavasena means by way of time-addhāna. This word 'addhāna' indeed denotes both time and place. Therein, after illustrating place-addhāna by way of example, 'yathā hi' and so on is stated to make known the length and shortness of in-breaths and out-breaths by way of time-addhāna. Therein, 'okāsaddhāna' means addhāna that is a location. 'Pharitvā' means having pervaded. Even fine particles, by being many clusters, cover a long addhāna—meaning a long region. Therefore, because of their slow progression and long continuity, they are called 'long.' And here it should be understood that the length and shortness of in-breaths and out-breaths in the bodies of elephants, etc., and in the bodies of dogs, etc., are stated by way of time-addhāna, distinguished by place-addhāna, according to the statement: 'They fill slowly and exit slowly; they fill quickly and exit quickly.' 'Among humans' means even in human bodies of similar size. 'They breathe in long' means they cause a long series of in-breaths to proceed; this is the meaning. The same method applies also to 'they breathe out.' The connection is: like dogs, hares, and so on, they breathe in short and breathe out short. But this long and short in-breathing and out-breathing should be seen as the nature of the bodies of those beings. The word 'tesaṃ' means 'of those beings.' The word 'te' means 'those in-breaths and out-breaths.' 'Ittaramaddhāna' means a short time. 'By nine modes': for one applying themself to meditation who has not yet attained a subsequent distinction from a previous one, there are the three modes stated from the beginning solely by way of addhāna. And those are: one person carefully marks the in-breath, another the out-breath, and another both—this is by way of these three persons. Some, however, say that the phrase 'breathes in and breathes out' is a single statement for the purpose of showing the uninterrupted occurrence of the meditation. By way of desire, there are three as before; similarly, by way of joy, there are three—thus, by these nine modes.

entries.pali: 7 . Nipaccakārassā ti paṇāmakiriyāya. Ānubhāvenā ti balena. Sosetvā ti sukkhāpetvā antaradhāpetvā atthaṃ pakāsayissāmīti sambandho. Antarāye ti atthappakāsanassa upaghātake. Asesato ti nissese sakale.
entries.chinese_simplified: 7. ‘以谦恭’即以礼敬的行为。‘以威力’即以力量。‘令干涸’即令枯竭、令消失，此词与‘我将阐明其义’相关联。‘诸障碍’即对阐明意义的诸种危害。‘无余’即无有残余，全部。
entries.english: 7. “Of one who shows respect” (nipaccakārassa) means by the act of homage. “By the power” (ānubhāvena) means by the strength. “Having dried up” (sosetvā) means having caused to dry up, having made disappear; the connection is with “I will explain the meaning.” “Obstacles” (antarāye) means that which destroys the explanation of the meaning. “Completely” (asesato) means without remainder, entirely.

entries.pali: Thero na detī ti kathamahaṃ etena ñāto, kenaci kiñci ācikkhitaṃ siyāti saññāya na adāsi. Teneva ‘‘mayampi na jānāmā’’ti vuttaṃ. Aparassā ti aparassa bhikkhuno pattaṃ ādāya…pe… therassa hatthe ṭhapesīti yojanā. Anāyatane ti nikkāraṇe, ayutte vā nassanaṭṭhāne. Tuvaṃ attānaṃ rakkheyyāsi, mayaṃ pana mahallakattā kiṃ rakkhitvā karissāma, mahallakattā eva ca rakkhituṃ na sakkhissāmāti adhippāyo. Anāgāmittā vā thero attanā vattabbaṃ jānitvā ovadati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 长老不给，他心想：‘我怎么被他知道了？或许有人告诉了什么。’因此不给。因此才说：‘我们也不知道。’‘其他’，意指拿了其他比丘的钵……然后放在长老的手里，这是句子的连接方式。‘于不当处’，意指没有理由，或在不该丢失的地方丢失。‘你应该保护自己，我们这些老了的人，即使保护了又能做什么呢？而且因为年老，实际上也保护不了自己’，这是其意。或者，长老作为阿那含，知道自己该说什么，因此给予教导。
entries.english: The elder did not give, with the perception, 'How am I known by him? Someone must have told him something.' Because of this perception, he did not give. For that reason, it was said, 'We too do not know.' `Aparassa` means: taking the bowl of another monk... he placed it in the elder's hand—this is the connection. `Anāyatane` means without cause, or in an unsuitable place of destruction. The intention is: 'You should protect yourself. But we, being old, what shall we do by protecting ourselves? And just because we are old, we will not be able to protect ourselves.' Or, the elder, due to being a non-returner, advises, knowing what should be said by him.

entries.pali: Adhippāyenā ti akusalānantaraṃ sahetukatadārammaṇaṃ natthīti tassa therassa matimattanti dasseti. ‘‘Kusalākusale niruddhe sahetuko vipāko tadārammaṇatā uppajjatī’’ti (paṭṭhā. 3.1.98) vacanato pana akusalānantaraṃ sahetukatadārammaṇampi vijjatiyevāti uppattiṃ vadantassa yuttaggahaṇavasenāti adhippāyo.
entries.chinese_simplified: ‘依意趣’者，此为显示‘不善之后无有因彼所缘’仅是彼长老之见。然根据《发趣论》(Paṭṭhāna 3.1.98)圣典：‘善与不善灭时，有因异熟作为彼所缘生起’，不善之后实有有因彼所缘。说其生起者的意趣是，依于取其适合（之义）。
entries.english: By "intention," it is meant to show the mere opinion of that elder that there is no rooted registration immediately following unwholesome consciousness. However, according to the statement, "When wholesome and unwholesome states cease, a rooted resultant arises as registration" (Paṭṭhāna 3.1.98), there indeed exists a rooted registration immediately following unwholesome consciousness. Thus, the intention of one who speaks of its arising is by way of accepting what is appropriate.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Upanidhāpaññatti pi etissā eva pabhedā, sā pana ‘‘dīghaṃ upanidhāya rasso, rassaṃ upanidhāya dīgho’’tiādinayappavattā ‘‘kapaṇaṃ mānusakaṃ rajjaṃ dibbasukhaṃ upanidhāyā’’ti evamādikā ca, tasmā paññapetabbato ca paññāpanato ca paññattīti veditabbā. Samaññā samattā.
entries.chinese_simplified: 依附施设(Upanidhāpaññatti)也是它的一个分支，它是以“依长而说短，依短而说长”等方式运作，例如“与天界之乐相比，人间王国是可怜的”等等。因此，应当知道“施设”之名，是源于所施设法(paññapetabba)与能施设法(paññāpana)。施设总说终。
entries.english: The designation by comparison is also a subdivision of this. It proceeds by such methods as, 'in comparison to the long, there is the short; in comparison to the short, there is the long,' and so on, and also by such statements as, 'in comparison to wretched human kingship, there is divine bliss,' and the like. Therefore, it should be understood that it is a designation (paññatti) because it is what is to be designated and because of the act of designating. The exposition of designations is complete.

entries.work_title: 阿毗达摩入门-名色分别 Abhidhammāvatāro-Nāmarūpaparicchedo
entries.pali: Dīghamassāsapassāsā, rassaṃ vātha tathā dvayaṃ; Satimā matisampanno, paṭhamaṃ parigaṇhati.
entries.chinese_simplified: 具念且具慧者，首先遍知长入出息，或短入出息。
entries.english: Long in-breaths and out-breaths, or short ones, or both likewise—the mindful one endowed with wisdom first comprehends them.
